Hoặc bạn cũng có thể dùng thùng xốp nhiề.en: Or you might use a wide-hole styling barrel to hold the fabric when transporting. And put them in the car's refrigeration. Packing a Styrofoam with a clear vent will help reduce the impact of the fabric in the cooling chamber. In addition, you can use polyetylen plastic bags and then carry the fruit or wrap it. This will help to make the fabric color beautiful, and it will not cause water loss.
Hoặc bạn cũng có thể dùng thùng xốp nhiề.zh: 或者你可能用一个宽孔的造型管 来牵住布料运输。 把它们放进汽车冷藏室 用一个清晰的通气口来包装一个斯太罗泡沫会有助于降低冷却室中织物的影响. 此外,还可以使用多肽塑料袋,再携带果实或包裹. 这会帮助使织物颜色美丽,不会造成缺水.

Một trong những cách bảo quản vải thiều.en: One of the ways in which the fabric is maintained when the transport is most applied is in the Styrofoam. The Styrofoam will help the fabric to avoid the effects of the collision during transport, keeping the cloth fresher. Note, too, that the Styrofoam hold the heat of the fabric must have enough of enough ice to cool it within 24 hours. Remember to close and wrap the Styrofoam can, so that the rocks are melted quickly or the water that flows out breaks the fabric.
Một trong những cách bảo quản vải thiều.zh: 在运输应用最多时织物的维持方式之一是在石化泡沫中. 石灰泡沫将帮助织物避免运输过程中碰撞的影响,使布料保持新鲜. 请注意,石化泡沫在织物的热量中必须有足够的冰在24小时内冷却. 记得关闭和包裹 石化泡沫罐, 这样岩石会迅速融化 或流出的水打破织物。

Những lưu ý bảo quản vải thiều khi vận c.zh: 在运输时保存织物的注解

Nếu chuyển số lượng vải thiều ít, có thể.en: If a small amount of fabric is transferred, it can be wrapped in newspapers. And put it in plastic or plastic bags.
Nếu chuyển số lượng vải thiều ít, có thể.zh: 如果转让少量的织物,可以包裹在报纸上. 并放入塑料袋或塑料袋中.

Phương tiện vận chuyển cũng là một trong.en: Transportation is also one of the factors affecting the quality of fabric. Select the type of car that meets sufficient fabric cooling requirements when the distance is moved. Make sure the canvas doesn't rot, don't crush when it's delivered to the user.
Phương tiện vận chuyển cũng là một trong.zh: 运输也是影响织物质量的因素之一. 在移动距离时选择符合足够布料冷却要求的车型. 确保画布不会腐烂,在交付给用户时不要粉碎.

Sau khi đã ngâm vải trong hai loại dung.en: After you have soaked the cloth in the top two, use the wind fan to blow the fruit or to dry it naturally. To be able to preserve the most fresh and clean cloth. Take a liter of fresh water and mix it in around 60g NaHSO3, and then just melt it all. Take each of the cloths embedded in the NaHSO3 and the budget for about 10 minutes. Thanks to this solution, the fabric will be hardwareised with the shell, water loss limit, and the destruction of bacteria, fungi that damage the fruit. After 10 minutes, you pull out the cloth and then you dip in the HCI 4% solution from 3 to 5 minutes. This process will help keep the colors bright and beautiful.
Sau khi đã ngâm vải trong hai loại dung.zh: 将布浸在前二后,用风扇吹开果实或自然干. 以能保存最新净布. 取一升淡水,混入60g NaHSO3左右,然后全部融化. 将嵌入NaHSO3的布和预算的每件布带约10分钟. 由于这个溶液,织物会用外壳,水损限,以及破坏细菌,破坏果实的真菌来硬化. 10分钟后,你拔出布,然后从3到5分钟的HCI 4%的溶液中浸泡. 这个过程将有助于保持颜色明亮和美丽.

Thời điểm thu hoạch vải thiều hợp lý nhấ.en: The time of the harvest is most reasonable is when its shell is ripe. Counting from the time the flower blooms, it is about three months to harvest. In particular, people need to take note to pick up the cloth on sunny days, not harvesting the fabric on rainy days. Finish picking up cloths and force them into clusters from 3 kg to 5 kg. Remove the unquality fabrics, such as decay, rot, or crush, the strange form.
Thời điểm thu hoạch vải thiều hợp lý nhấ.zh: 收获时间最合理的是其壳熟时. 从开花时间算起,收获时间约为三个月. 特别是人们需要注意在阳光灿烂的日子拾起布料,而不是在雨天收获布料. 收拾好布料 把它们装成3公斤到5公斤的集群 移除不合格的织物,如腐烂,腐烂,或粉碎,奇异的形式.

Trong trường hợp xuất vải thiều số lượng.en: In the case of large quantities of fabric output, it is necessary to preserve them with appropriate chemicals. The fluid use is NaHSO3 and HCl 4%, which will help the fabric to be strong, retain the quality and color.
Trong trường hợp xuất vải thiều số lượng.zh: 如果织物输出量大,必须用适当的化学品保存。 流体使用为NaHSO3和HCl4%,这将有助于织物坚固,保持质量和颜色.
